<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown hash --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown hash [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--jobs <JOBS>`
: Readers per device; 1 suits spinning disks, raise it for SSDs. Default: `1`.

`--retry-errors`
: Retry files that failed to read last time.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Hashes only what could be a duplicate: a file whose size no other file shares is never read. Then a sample (the first, middle and last 64 KiB) and, for files whose samples still match, the full SHA-256. Files on drives that aren't connected wait for them. See [Hashes and proof](/docs/concepts/#hashes-and-proof).

## Examples

```sh
backdown hash
# an SSD: two readers per device
backdown hash --jobs 2
# try the files that couldn't be read last time again
backdown hash --retry-errors
```
